description:
Goal

A demanded TransportShape(position) monotonically refines exact semantic producer/use relations into one physical representation. ABI, backend, interpreter, and native consumers use that answer directly; no lower layer reselects identity from Ty, joined physical surfaces, ShapeId, ordering, or session inventories.

North-star contract

- There is no transport seal, completion pass, whole-world census, or no-change completion signal.
- One requested product produces from exact current fact/product reads or returns exact waits.
- Completion is relative to the exact OutgoingEdgeFrontier generation already requested by the product DAG.
- Dependency states and generations are memo metadata, never ProductValue data.
- Only actual product back-edges form a local settlement group.
- Refinement preserves upstream identity and relations; it never reconstructs them from a physical summary.
- One local semantic authority must not be duplicated into a second Ty/demand snapshot merely for transport.

Established foundation

fz-k22.5.1 provides immutable revisioned products, durable exact fact/product dependencies, final FactMovement states, atomic requested-publisher frontier generations, replaceable OutgoingInputEdges(E) contributions, IncomingInputRelations(root), exact IncomingInputSlot(slot) projections, and targeted closure retraction. This ticket consumes those authorities.

Proven paired callable case

The five-line fixture with two Enum.drop_while calls produces target reduce_while_cont/3 activation Ty(87), semantic input 2, with two exact CallArgument sources: reduce_while/3 Ty(81) ValueId(2) and Ty(219) ValueId(2).

The source values remain distinct semantic relations. Their child layouts are ShapeId(26)/CallableId(2)/ValueRef and ShapeId(29)/CallableId(3)/ValueRef; the target public carrier is ShapeId(39)/CallableId(4)/ValueRef. IncomingInputSource (ExecutableKey, ValueId, role) and CallableFlow preserve identity. Shape equality is not the semantic boundary.

The exact local branches are:

A: F172/Ty81 V2 -> F168/Ty69 V2 -> F70/Ty69 V2 -> F66/Ty41 V5 -> Lambda F160(captures=[V1])
B: F172/Ty219 V2 -> F168/Ty217 V2 -> F70/Ty217 V2 -> F66/Ty214 V5 -> Lambda F160(captures=[V1])

The candidate physical graph contains 50 shape nodes and 154 edges, including 2 capture children, 14 resolution inputs, 6 returns, and 27 shared dependencies. It is acyclic. Forward and reverse publisher service produce identical relations, layouts, generations, recipes, and graph. The candidate reaches 103 exact keys versus the legacy closure's 416 positions; this is graph size, not a runtime claim.

CallableDemand is sufficient use authority: resolved/targets with non-first-class use permits direct transport; opaque, escape, first-class use, or multiple identities requires the public ValueRef carrier. Zero relations is exact absence; a missing child is a wait. Equal child layouts never select one identity.

Proven recursive callable groups and publication

Actual recursive fixtures produce only exact TransportShape back-edges:

- self: X = join(A, X), SCC {X};
- mutual: X = join(A, Y), Y = join(X), SCC {X,Y};
- maplist: a one-member self SCC.

Recipe, slot, construction, and anchor dependencies remain outside those SCCs. A test-only ProductMemo group operation proves atomic installation for {X} and {X,Y}: every member and dependency is installed before external readers are invalidated, internal edges are excluded, only changed members advance generation, and no callback, telemetry handler, or user code runs during installation. Clean install, withdrawal, equal reproduction, changed anchors, reader invalidation, and forward/reverse order pass.

Complete legacy vocabulary inventory

- ExecutableReturn joins reachable LocalValue and CallsiteReturn sources.
- ExecutableInput(i) reads exact IncomingInputSlot identities, precise ActivationInputs type evidence, and input RuntimeDemand.
- LocalValue(v) has one normalized final origin after step origin, clause-input alias, call-result alias, and delivered join precedence.
- CallsiteReturn(c) names selected target ExecutableReturn children at the exact callsite need; provider boundary absence is explicit.
- Join names a canonical set of local/callsite children.
- TupleValue names ordered children under tuple-field demands.
- TupleField names its parent and field index.
- CallableValue names function/captures plus upstream CallableFlowFact.
- CallArg aliases Value; ReturnPayload names the direct callee return or CallsiteReturn; EntryCapture aliases Value; ResumePayload names the producer return or delivered local/callsite source according to stable body/callsite facts.
- Cross-executable call arguments and callable captures publish exact IncomingInputSource identities through CallInputMode, selected activations, needs, flow resolutions, and capture ordinals.

Proven authority correction

ActivationAnalysis and ExecutableFacts do not contain ActivationInputs. Recursive canonical activation keys deliberately converge non-dispatch identity: compiler2_activation_inputs_are_distinct_from_the_canonical_activation_key proves list(int) body evidence remains precise while the key becomes non-equivalent list(any). Deriving an input Ty from the key, clause values, or ShapeId would reverse-engineer discarded information.

No LocalTransportRecipes product is justified. ExecutableFacts(E) is the sole immutable local structural authority. It may normalize value origins, return sources, resume sources, position aliases, and selected mappings only when those replace equivalent raw LoweredBody interpretation. It never contains Ty, RuntimeDemand, ShapeId, TransportLayout, child answers, or copied CallableFlow.

TransportShape(Input) reads settled ActivationInputs, RuntimeDemand(E), IncomingInputSlot, and child shapes directly. Return reads settled ReturnType, RuntimeDemand, ExecutableFacts, and child products. Value reads ExecutableFacts analysis/type/origin, RuntimeDemand, and children. CallsiteReturn reads selected target return products. CallableConstruction reads function/captures from ExecutableFacts and flow from RuntimeDemand.

The full-vocabulary fixture proof covers all 13 legacy source/position categories across pair_down, an opaque branch join, maplist, a direct tail return, and paired drop_while. A reachable opaque/provider callsite may have no selected summary; local CallArg flow remains named while target absence remains explicit.

Proven all-shape refinement and carrier

The real pair_down fixture has R = join(Tuple(int,int), R). For a fixed authoritative generic (Ty,demand) layout, the finite recursive domain is absence; exact lane/callable/tuple children; public callable; and boxed value. Equal layouts remain exact. Tuple joins are pointwise. Distinct concrete callable fields may widen to an authoritative public callable inside an exact tuple. Alternatives admitted by a union/value-lane authority widen to the boxed layout. Only a candidate not below the recursive authoritative layout is an invariant error.

TransportCarrier is an independent Absent < ValueRef dimension of the same final TransportLayout. It OR-joins through named structural/equality edges. Seeds come from RuntimeDemand public/first-class use, ExecutableFacts closure-call payload mode, and the CallableConstruction answer that owns capture ABI. Carrier is never inferred from ShapeId or session publication inventories.

No-anchor, equal anchors, self recursion, nested callable widening, union widening, incompatible structure, carrier propagation, forward/reverse traversal, source replacement, withdrawal, and equal reproduction pass through the existing atomic ProductMemo group mechanism. Internal SCC edges are excluded from retained dependencies; exact external reads remain durable. No source form remains unmodeled.

Implementation strategy

1. Replace ExecutableFacts' duplicate delivered-join/callable-producer views and transport.rs' separate LocalCallableProducer/TransportSource reconstruction with one minimal normalized local origin vocabulary inside ExecutableFacts. Preserve explicit absent selected targets.
2. Make each TransportShape(position) consume that structural authority plus its exact settled fact/product reads. Produce structural layout and carrier together. Callsite returns name selected target returns; executable inputs name IncomingInputSlot children; callable construction owns capture/input/return/boundary refinement.
3. Detect only concrete reentered TransportShape keys, settle that exact SCC from bottom under the authoritative generic layout, and publish every member atomically through ProductMemo. No construction, recipe, slot, or anchor key is swept into the group.
4. Delete the whole closure solver and its compensations: ExecutableContext/TransportContexts closure inventories, ShapeConstraintGraph/PositionUnion, Cycle/ProjectionMemo, component products, selector/fallback, manufactured demand, consult/freshness ledgers, session transport closure state, closure ids in absence values, temporary probes, and obsolete cache/resource tests. Replace mechanical ShapeId/component assertions with behavioral or architectural intent tests; do not preserve obsolete resource floors.
5. Update northstar and agent documentation to describe direct position refinement, exact local authorities, recursive group settlement, and carrier ownership. Remove all WIP spike scaffolding and noisy eprintln probes.

Rejected boundaries

- filtering identities through joined demand, rendered Ty, ShapeId, CallableId, debug order, or physical equality;
- generic fallback as semantic evidence;
- recovering identity downstream after boxing;
- treating a dependency cone as an SCC;
- sequential per-key publication presented as atomic settlement;
- a parallel stamped cache/facade;
- historical ExecutableTransportFacts;
- LocalTransportRecipes as a duplicate authority carrying copied types and demands.

Signal

- The paired input pulls both exact producer children and no unrelated component; both identities survive into one public callable ABI.
- Precise input layouts depend on settled ActivationInputs, not the converged activation key.
- Every transport position is one local structural mapping plus exact named fact/product reads.
- Recursive settlement groups exactly reentered shape keys and publishes no provisional value.
- Callable and non-callable lattices are finite, schedule-independent, replacement-safe, and explicit about invalid states.
- Forward and reverse schedules produce equal values and generations without debug/render sorting.
- Whole-closure projection, inventories, selectors/fallbacks, manufactured demand, and custom freshness state are deleted, not bypassed.
- Full library tests, targeted fixtures, strict all-target clippy, formatting, and before/after product/work measurements pass.

Scope

All proof gates have passed; production implementation is authorized under the strategy above. fz-k22.30 remains blocked until this lands. fz-k22.31 owns the uncalled first-class discrepancy. fz-k22.29 may consume the landed authority only after it exists.
title: Make transport shape a product-owned refinement
